text:
samir: Heads up — noticed EU hedging is doubling egress cost for a few tenants during mid-day. Seems tied to the new 'hedge-on-latency' tweak we rolled last week. Anyone else seeing this? cc @elaine

elaine: yup saw that. hedging kicks when p50>80ms and falls back to eu-west2 replica; but region penalty math pushes weight to eu leading to duplicate requests. short-term fix: clamp hedging replicas per-tenant. longer-term: move cost-aware objective into resolver.

tom: can we get an example of the policy that caused it? maybe the runtime is picking max(availability,priority) incorrectly

samir: here's the rule we shipped:
```policy
route "customer-v1" {
  hedging {
    when latency.p50 > 80ms
    replicas = 2
    region_preference = ["eu-west2", "eu-central1"]
    cost_penalty = 0.1
  }
  fallback { to: "global-llm-small" }
}
```

elaine: that cost_penalty is additive to region_score; our normal cost window uses multiplicative scaling. mismatch causes eu score to stay high -> more hedges. ops note: the runtime uses additive normalization for legacy rules. fix should be either normalize to multiplicative or expose `penalty_mode: additive|multiplicative` in DSL

josh: telemetry: I captured traces with trace_id=tx-7890. query:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(cost_tokens) as cost FROM routing_events
WHERE trace_id='tx-7890' GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

infra-bot: deploy status: policy-stage -> canary completed (5/5 hosts). @samir @elaine

samir: thanks. proposal: short-term patch: restrict hedging per-region by budget token and default penalty_mode=multiplicative. long-term: move hedging decision into policy-eval sandbox so we can simulate cost impact before hotload.

elaine: agree. I'll open an RFC for policy-eval-sandbox + backward-compat flags. will include a small sim harness (1% traffic) + metrics diff. assign @josh to telemetry part

josh: on it. I'll add dashboards: hedging_rate by tenant, hedged_tokens, and incremental cost. also add a regression alert if incremental cost > 30%/hour

tom: minor — ensure we capture 'replica_count' in route-explain so debuggers can see why multiple requests were issued

samir: ok will follow up with a PR to add penalty_mode to DSL and a migration plan. thanks all :thumbsup:
